title: c4-brief — the judgement layer of a programme, as typed claims that expire
description: What an agent (or a person) asserts about where the programme stands: one thesis, the risks, what needs a decision, how each invariant is guarded, notes. Every claim names its subject (`about`), cites evidence that must resolve, and carries provenance stamped by Forma (`writtenAt`, `evidenceHash`) — never by the fill. A claim is rendered with a colour only while an independent counter-verifier holds it and its evidence has not moved; otherwise it is shown grey and says so. Written only by `forma audit --apply`; the reader's trust is the whole product.

kind.description: thesis: where we stand, in one sentence (at most one). risk: what could sink it, with first-hand evidence (at most 5). decide: what only a human can settle now (at most 5). invariant: how a declared invariant is guarded. note: anything else worth keeping, no colour.

severity.description: Only meaningful for risk and invariant; a decide has no severity, it has a question.

about.description: The subject the claim is about — what makes it go stale when it changes. Exactly one key.

class.description: invariant only: a test/gate goes red when it breaks (MECCANIZZATO), it is written down and nothing checks it (DOCUMENTATO), or neither (SCOPERTO).

ifBroken.description: invariant only: what falls if it falls. An invariant without a declared consequence is an opinion.

writtenAt.description: Manifest day on which Forma accepted the claim; never supplied by the fill.

staleAfterDays.description: Overrides the manifest's staleAfterDays for this claim.

verified.description: The independent counter-verifier's last verdict on this claim, stamped by Forma at apply. Colour is granted only on a fresh `holds`.
